name: Checkpoint 01 - Ticket Triage v1 (OpenRouter, Test Ready, Error Paths)

nodes.name: 01 Trigger
nodes.notes: Manual trigger first; webhook after it works.

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: I was charged twice this month for my subscription.

nodes.name: 02 Set fields
nodes.notes: Edit these 3 values per test case: request_id, received_at, message.

nodes.name: 02b Input Guard
nodes.notes: Catches empty/missing message before wasting an LLM call.

nodes.name: 03 LLM
nodes.notes: OpenRouter (OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions). Contract prompt sent as system message. Credential: HTTP Header Auth, header name 'Authorization', value 'Bearer YOUR_OPENROUTER_KEY'. Swap 'model' to whichever OpenRouter model slug you have access to. 15s timeout; continueOnFail=true routes API/timeout failures to the error path instead of crashing.

nodes.name: 04 Parse + validate
nodes.notes: Required keys, confidence 0-1, known category. Returns structured result, never throws.

nodes.name: 05 Route
nodes.notes: Low confidence / high risk -> human review. Invalid -> error. Else -> auto_tagged (fallback output).

assignments.name: log_entry
assignments.value: ={{ { request_id: $json.request_id, received_at: $json.received_at, raw_output: { category: $json.category || null, confidence: $json.confidence || null, summary: $json.summary || null, risk: $json.risk || null, needs_human: $json.needs_human || null }, status: $json.route, queue: $json.queue || null, error: $json.error || null } }}

nodes.name: 06 Persist
nodes.notes: Append result, status, raw output, error. All three routes converge here.
